title: Meta-OS Universal Day-0 Ignite, Polymorphic Archetype Synthesizer, Worktree Executor & Obsidian Cockpit Suite
problem_statement: Katman A cekirdegi (A1..A9) kilitlenmis olmasina ragmen, bu sablon klonlanip yeni bir proje baslatildiginda; (1) 6 farkli proje arketipini (Backend_API, FullStack_Web, Data_ML_Pipeline, CLI_SDK, Autonomous_Agent, Embedded_IoT) dil-bagimsiz olarak baglayacak polimorfik profil sentezleyicinin, (2) NotebookLM'den gelen .antigravity/genesis/research_briefing.md ve project_manifest.json girdilerini I-14 (UntrustedContentEnvelope) ile temizleyip IntentContract uretecek derleyicinin, (3) degisiklikleri /tmp altinda izole git worktree icinde kosturup Uclu RED/GREEN Oracle (V12-05) ve imzali ProofReceipt (receipts/pointers/latest_proof.json) uretecek yurutucunun, (4) sifir LLM token'i ile (I-07) Obsidian Graph View ([[wikilink]]) ve Mermaid diyagramli canli kokpit uretecek projeksiyon motorunun ve (5) kullanicinin hicbir adimi unutmamasi icin basvuracagi Türkçe docs/IGNITE_GUIDE.md rehberinin Katman B'de insa edilmesi.

desired_outcomes.statement: DO-1: Polymorphic Archetype Registry & Ignite Compiler (src/metaos_ignite/archetypes.py & compiler.py, ./scripts/ignite)
desired_outcomes.measurable_criterion: All 6 universal archetypes and 5 language toolchain templates synthesize deterministically; research_briefing.md + project_manifest.json compile through I-14 into a schema-valid IntentContract and ProjectArchetypeProfile.

desired_outcomes.statement: DO-2: Worktree Sandbox Executor, Triple RED Oracle & Proof Assembler (src/metaos_ignite/executor.py & proof.py, ./scripts/worktree_exec, ./scripts/assemble_proof)
desired_outcomes.measurable_criterion: Executes inside isolated /tmp git worktree (I-09), enforces V12-05 Triple RED/GREEN oracle with dual seeded replay stability, and emits Ed25519-signed ProofReceipt with Meta-Metrics at receipts/by-run/<run_id>/<hash>.json and receipts/pointers/latest_proof.json.

desired_outcomes.statement: DO-3: Obsidian Vault & Mermaid Cockpit Projector (src/metaos_ignite/cockpit.py, ./scripts/project_cockpit)
desired_outcomes.measurable_criterion: Zero-LLM-token deterministic projection (I-07) generates docs/cockpit/{DASHBOARD,STATE_GRAPH,DECISION_QUEUE,EVIDENCE_LEDGER}.md with valid [[wikilink]] edges and Mermaid state/evidence diagrams.

desired_outcomes.statement: DO-4: Unutmama Kilavuzu & Hazir Baslangic Sablonlari (docs/IGNITE_GUIDE.md & .antigravity/genesis/templates/)
desired_outcomes.measurable_criterion: Comprehensive Turkish step-by-step operator guide (NotebookLM -> Antigravity -> Obsidian) and starter templates exist and pass secret/link verification.

non_goals: Live Jira/Confluence/GitHub remote API calls (local outbox and file projections are primary per I-11).
External Docker containers or third-party pip/npm packages (100% hermetic stdlib-only runtime).
constraints: Strict compliance with Meta-OS Architectural Invariants I-01..I-15 and patches C-1..C-8, V12-01..V12-06.
100% hermetic Python 3 standard library, POSIX sh, sqlite3, git, and ssh-keygen runtime.
Zero external network calls and zero secret literals in repository.

assumptions.statement: Host provides python3, git, sqlite3, and OpenSSH ssh-keygen with -Y signing support.
Ed25519 private keys remain isolated in /tmp/metaos-keystore outside repository working tree.
